title: Seven hand-rolled atomic-write implementations with different durability guarantees
note: Core confirmed: credentials/store.go:196-225 uses afero.TempFile, fsyncs the file, renames, and never fsyncs the parent dir; hubendpoint/runtime.go:196 syncDir and auth/openai/storage.go:229 authSyncUnsupported carry the same ENOSYS/ENOTSUP/EINVAL tolerance; rendezvous.go:96 and evener-migrate/convert.go:242 use a fixed '.tmp' name (rendezvous also never fsyncs); plugins/atomic.go has 6 seam vars (atomicMkdirAll/ReadEntropy/OpenFile/Remove/Rename/OpenDir). Overstated: selfupdate/update.go:820 stageExecutable is a streaming binary copy (ctx-aware, 0755) not a data write, so it does not belong in the helper's first pass; credentials save() streams toml.Encoder into the file so the helper needs an io.Writer/callback variant or the caller must encode to bytes first. No demonstrated bug, only drift, so 'actively causes bugs' is soft.
revised_fix_plan: Same helper, but scope it to the 8 real write-bytes sites (drop selfupdate stageExecutable). Offer Write(path, data, Options{Perm, Fs, SyncDir}) and have credentials encode to a bytes.Buffer first. Migrate credentials first (adds the missing parent fsync) and keep its random-name policy as the default; keep the 0644 survey cache via Perm.

title: XDG state/config root resolution copied into about nine packages with drifting fallbacks
note: Confirmed copies and drift: rendezvous.go:42-60 ('.' on home failure, raw env), cmdutil/statedir.go:25-50 ('.', raw), auth/openai/storage.go:90-103 (os.TempDir(), Trimmed()), appwire/frame_recorder.go:95-103 (relative .local/state), agent/runtime_dir.go:75-83 and agent/doctor/statedir.go:29-37 (os.TempDir()), plus evener-migrate/main.go:129-137 and legacymigration.go:79-100. The 'duplicated to avoid dependency' comments are false for rendezvous (it already imports envvars) because envvars/userdirs depends only on envvars. cmdutil.DefaultSkillsDir/DefaultPluginsRoot are used in 11 non-definition places and duplicate userdirs.UserSkills/PluginStore. Caveats: agent/doctor/statedir.go also honors EVENER_STATE_DIR first so it is not a pure copy; userdirs.ConfigRoot deliberately returns '' on home failure while cmdutil falls back to '.', so unifying is a policy decision. Impact only shows when HOME is unresolvable, so downgrade to medium.
revised_fix_plan: Add userdirs.StateRoot beside ConfigRoot with one table test. Do the pure dedup first (rendezvous, appwire, evener-migrate, legacymigration, cmdutil skill/plugin helpers) keeping each caller's current home-failure result via an explicit parameter; unify the fallback policy as a separate step after asking Jesse.

title: tool-fluency re-implements cmd/evener launch plumbing with a drifted applyFastCheapModel
note: Confirmed: runnerApplyFastCheapModel (main.go:1357) is applyFastCheapModel (serve.go:2183) with a literal message instead of errFastCheapProviderUnavailable; parseLiveSandboxNet (main.go:1134) is byte-identical to parseSandboxNet (sandbox.go:165); runnerInitialProfile repeats ParseAllowedDecisions(Getenv) as serve.go:2138. Correction: the claim that provisionLiveSandboxWithHost 'drops' PickFreshSessionID is misleading. The fluency caller runs agent.PickFreshSessionID at main.go:1216 right before provisionLiveSandbox, which is the same ordering production has; production just folds it into provisionSandboxWithHost. No behavior drift there, only structural duplication.
revised_fix_plan: Same plan (move ApplyFastCheapModel, ParseSandboxNet, ConfigureSandbox, ProvisionSandbox into cmdutil), but fold PickFreshSessionID into the shared ProvisionSandbox so both callers get it from one place; drop the 'drops PickFreshSessionID' rationale from the PR description.

title: Plugin-store rename and metadata migrations for older layouts run on every store lock
note: Evidence confirmed: marketplace_migration.go 1282 lines (439 comment lines), metadata_migration.go 343, tests 4261+774+590+170=5795; lockStore (locks.go:84-97) calls migrateMarketplaceNames and ensureManagedContentMigrated on every acquisition and fails the acquisition if the marketplaces file is unparseable. git log: #1065 and #1180 on 2026-09-12, #1825 on 2026-09-17. Caveat: this is not a plain cleanup. docs/product/subsystems.md S17 and S18 state the migration as a product contract (automatic marketplace-name migration rekeys ownership without moving caches, interrupted-rename recovery, session continuity across migration). Removal is a backward-compat/product-promise change that needs Jesse's explicit decision, and the 'raw' LOC deltas (-1600/-5800) assume zero replacement code. ensureManagedContentMigrated lives in store_format.go, not locks.go. Features are only ~6 weeks old, so whether old-layout stores exist is a question only Jesse can answer.
revised_fix_plan: Do not queue as a refactor. Ask Jesse whether any store older than 2026-09-12 can still exist. If not, delete as proposed and rewrite the S17/S18 rows in the same PR; if yes, keep, and at most take the cheap win of making the lockStore migration not fail unrelated operations (disable/gc) on a corrupt marketplaces file.

title: Serf-era and pre-registry migration tools shipped permanently; evener-migrate duplicates homeRootFiles with a false justification
note: Part (a) confirmed: migrate/main.go:88-91 says it is duplicated because evener-migrate 'does not import cmdutil', but the package is invoked as 'evener migrate' (cmd/evener/main.go:21 imports it) and already imports envvars; cmdutil/legacymigration.go:19 holds the same 9 names. Importing cmdutil from migrate would drag agent/llm but it ships in the same binary anyway; better home is envvars/userdirs. Part (b) overreaches: cmd/evener-doctor/reconstruct.go (593 lines) rebuilds transcripts from an AgentsView archive, which is a recovery tool, not Serf-era compat, and sits squarely in the recovery-over-lockdown principle; it should not be bundled into a sunset. Line counts roughly right (migrate 801 prod, transcript-v2 408, reconstruct 593). ErrLegacySerfData (legacymigration.go:33) refuses launches to protect unmigrated user data; removing it needs a sunset decision.
revised_fix_plan: (a) Move the 9-name list into envvars/userdirs, have both packages use it, delete the false comment (-25). (b) Separate PR, needs Jesse's sunset call: ErrLegacySerfData, evener-migrate and the transcript v1 upgrader only. Leave reconstruct.go out.

title: Coverage-chasing 'fuzz' targets that discard their input and hand-listed FuzzPackageUnion replays
note: Confirmed: 22 'f.Fuzz(func(t *testing.T, _ uint8)' sites exist, but they include out-of-slice ones (cmd/evener-hub, appwiredoc). credentials/package_union_fuzz_test.go hand-lists 8 Test funcs plus a fault-FS scenario under //go:build evenerfuzz; plugins/package_union_fuzz_test.go lists 96 of 517 Test funcs (112 lines); fuzz-targets.txt registers them. Caveat: docs/developing-evener/coverage.md:9,56 documents the union of test track and fuzz-seed replay as the coverage-floor metric, so this is a deliberate (if odd) design, and deleting it moves the blessed floors. The fault-injection scenarios in coverage_*_fuzz files only appear there and are what raises the number; they are the test-of-mocked-behavior smell.
revised_fix_plan: Needs Jesse's decision on the coverage-union metric first. If kept, generate the replay list instead of hand-listing; if dropped, delete package_union_* and coverage_*_fuzz files, re-bless floors, update coverage.md, fuzzing.md and fuzz-targets.txt in the same PR.

title: Hand-rolled TOML line scanner in evener-tomlcheck misses nested keys
note: Scanner is real (main.go:187-345, tomlKeyLineRe at 192 only matches a leading key, no inline-table handling or tests). But the checker reports line numbers and supports an 'evener:naming-ignore' line marker; BurntSushi/toml's MetaData gives key paths but no positions, so a decoder rewrite does not obviously simplify and may lose ignore handling. Fix size -150 is unproven.
revised_fix_plan: Document the inline-table limitation in the tool's header; revisit only if a nested key violation slips through.
